summary.en: High fever for three days with pain behind the eyes and body ache; dengue suspected. Stop Combiflam, Dengue NS1 and CBC today. Dolo 650 three times a day while fever lasts and Electral through the day; review tomorrow with reports, come at once if abdominal pain or vomiting.

instructions.text: Do not take any other painkiller on your own
Come immediately if there is abdominal pain or vomiting

open_questions: Dolo 650 is to be taken while the fever lasts. Stop once fever is gone?
Electral is to be sipped through the day. For how many days?
